reason: A browser-based DSH plugin that notifies users when tasks finish by playing synthesized sounds and showing contextual toast or system notifications with session status and statistics.

summaries.zh: 这是一个在任务完成或中断时播放提示音并显示页面内或浏览器系统通知的 DSH 浏览器插件。
summaries.en: A DSH browser plugin that plays synthesized sounds and displays in-page or browser system notifications when tasks finish or stop.

capabilities: Detects task completion and result states from session data
Displays in-page toast notifications and browser system notifications
Shows session statistics and recap text in notifications
Stores notification settings in browser localStorage
Invokes the host LLM once per run to generate a short recap
